Three years later, Bruce has built a life around that promise. He's raising Dick, Jason, Tim, and little Damian while balancing Wayne Enterprises, the Batcave, and being Batman. He tells himself he's fine. He tells everyone he's fine. Then Clark Kent starts becoming a permanent part of their lives. Between chaotic breakfasts, sick days, arguments, family dinners, old grief, and four children who seem determined to make sure Bruce never gets a moment of peace, Bruce slowly learns something he never thought he could:He doesn't have to do this alone.
